questions.stem: A 44-year-old female patient presents with abdominal pain. The ER physician orders an abdominal ultrasound as part of the initial evaluation of the patient. It demonstrates multiple focal dilations of both the intrahepatic and extrahepatic biliary tree. Which of the following statements regarding this patient’s lesion is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Estrogen and progesterone are thought to play a role in the pathogenesis of this patient’s lesion.

options.label: B
options.text: Anatomical and/or functional obstructions likely contribute to the pathogenesis of these lesions.

options.label: D
options.text: This patient’s lesion places her at an increased risk for cholangiocarcinoma.
